decision: CLARIFY clock-domain, rate and suspend limits

sources.supports: CLOCK_MONOTONIC stops during suspend; CLOCK_BOOTTIME includes it
Implementation/resolution/monotonic/adjustable metadata; adjustable does not describe gradual rate changes
Linux suspend-aware clock is distinct from CLOCK_MONOTONIC

limits: Clock description is not an accuracy or scheduling measurement
Three synthetic tests do not exercise physical suspension or elapsed-age qualification
No host suspend, clock change, real transport or hardware experiment
No clock source, frozen threshold, runtime selection or production behavior change
No first-component or lane completion claim
retained_negative_evidence: Initial code-mode host spawn failed EAGAIN before policy read; identical bounded retry succeeded
